title: Composite Alternatives, Mixture Evidence, and Robust Stopping
finding: A predeclared mixture can represent uncertainty across several alternatives without post-hoc selection of whichever alternative looks strongest.
assumptions: Fixed Bernoulli null probability strictly between 0 and 1
Finite alternatives and weights fixed before looking at outcomes
Weights are nonnegative and sum to one
limitations: Not valid automatically for dependent data or arbitrary ML metrics
Audit and implementation do not prove empirical model quality
